classification.product: Opt-in protected edit screen, read-only editor-state endpoint, durable submitted input and S3-confirmed checkpoint. Review corrected a possible success message after state-read failure; invalid input remains editable. Fixed WordPress button CSS overriding the hidden resume control; final browser checks assert its actual visibility.
classification.test_infrastructure: Initial Selenium session creation timed out before UI tests; direct matching ChromeDriver worked, root cause of Grid timeout not established. Second run used HTML attribute rather than DOM property for textarea value; corrected. Prior failures retained privately. No product failure inferred from these.
classification.environment: New isolated WordPress/MariaDB/Chromium only; no public ports, production changes or cloud writes. S3 fault injection uses persistent contract double, not a new live S3 qualification.
